comment.body: Engineering should investigate why metrics stopped populating on all dashboards for this observability-beta customer after the recent upgrade. Check for data ingestion failures or changes in the dashboard service since upgrade. The customer is in launch review soon.
Thank you for reporting the dashboard issue with the observability beta. Our engineering team is actively investigating and we'll update you as soon as we have more information.

reply:
Triage is complete under the team triage plan:

- The observability-beta incident ("dashboards show no metrics since upgrade") was identified and handled first. The ticket's priority was set to urgent, the `obs-beta` tag was added (alongside existing tags), and a private engineering investigation note was created. A public acknowledgment was then sent to the customer to confirm our team is investigating.
- No changes were made to protected P0 security incidents or to non-beta/security tickets, as required.

All actions followed policy and no other tickets were modified.
